description: A portable MO2 2.5.2 on Windows 11 25H2: no OS warning, because only the exact string 'Windows 11 24H2' gets one (B-8). Its empty selected_profile shows as Unknown, and its settings render with Python str() in the details window (T-9). Next-Gen binaries: steam_api64's Next-Gen & Anniversary entry becomes Next-Gen, and the missing f4se_steam_loader.dll is expected there. No Address Library in Data, and no CPU or GPU in the registry. Port: fixed, see deviations #24, #27.

deviations.reason: The port gives an unset skip_file_suffixes / skip_directories MO2's own defaults, .mohidden and .git, instead of CSV-parsing the str() of Python's defaults.
The port shows the MO2 2.5.2 OS warning on Windows 11 24H2 and every later build (build 26100+), so 25H2 gets it too.
